mechanistic_interpretation.core_question: Does H-JEPA dynamically ground the current physical location of a target from RGB, or does it predominantly retrieve a task-conditioned canonical spatial expectation?
mechanistic_interpretation.relocated_target_finding: Evaluates navigation and visual goal heading when target is physically moved but verified in front camera FOV.
mechanistic_interpretation.token_vs_rgb_finding: Evaluates whether changing task token under fixed RGB redirects goal vector toward the newly designated object.
mechanistic_interpretation.conflict_finding: Evaluates agent behavior under explicit disagreement between categorical task token and visual salience.
